reactor_type: custom, viscous flow reactor with heated stainless steel tube
evidence: The LiF ALD timing sequences can be expressed as: t1−t2−t3−t4, where t1 is the LiOtBu exposure time, t3 is the HF exposure time, and t2 and t4 are the respective purge times for LiOtBu and HF, with all times in seconds. The timing sequence used here for LiF on Li is 5-5-1-5.
